attrs.why: node-3 choanal atresia, genital/cardiac anomalies; node-4 facial nerve/dysmorphism; node-5 ear dysplasia support CHARGE syndrome
node-3/4/5 show multisystem congenital anomalies suggesting a chromosomal/genetic syndrome, though less specific than CHARGE
Multisystem findings in node-3/4/5 refute isolated congenital anomalies; no evidence supports this hypothesis

attrs.why: New expert analysis reports a de novo CHD7 intronic variant, a known genetic cause of CHARGE syndrome, adding strong support. However, coloboma and semicircular canal aplasia/hypoplasia remain undocumented, so the diagnosis is clinically supported but not definitively confirmed. Confidence increases from 0.86 to 0.88.

The de novo CHD7 intronic variant specifically supports CHARGE syndrome, making a nonspecific chromosomal/genetic syndrome less likely as the primary explanation. Confidence decreases from 0.11 to 0.09.
Identification of a de novo CHD7 variant further refutes isolated congenital anomalies, as it indicates a specific genetic syndrome. Confidence remains very low at 0.03.

node-10.label: Coloboma and semicircular canal aplasia/hypoplasia are not documented
